verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about per-institution health: no documented institution status fields, no outage or degradation signals or status page, and no error-code taxonomy separating bank-side failures from client-side ones. Institution feature flags (e.g. INITIATE_PRE_AUTHORISATION) and payment-status webhooks are adjacent capabilities and do not cover institution health monitoring. The axis applies to an open banking aggregator, so absence of evidence yields none.
